_about: Every configurable choice in reconstructing John as heard. Each option names its evidence. build_john_model.py turns the chosen options into a full score: verse -> breath group -> word -> syllable -> phoneme, with timing, pitch, loudness, room and structure markers.

text._evidence: P66 and P75 lack 7:53-8:11; nomina sacra (abbreviated sacred names) were read aloud in full

options.attic: classical 5th-4th c. BC: pitch accent, distinct vowel lengths, aspirated stops
options.koine: 1st-2nd c. AD Greek East (Allen, Vox Graeca; Horrocks; Gignac's Egyptian papyri): ei = i, ai = e, o = omega, stress accent, length lost
options.koine-late: 3rd-4th c.: also eta = i, oi/y moving toward i, aspirates becoming fricatives

accent_options.pitch: classical musical accent, rise of about a fifth
accent_options.stress: Koine dynamic accent (loudness and length on the accented syllable)

pronunciation._evidence: round 15: 53-60% of variants in P66, 01 and 03 are same-sound spellings, so the scribes heard Koine values

voice._evidence: synagogue and church reading was a heightened recitation on a reciting tone (later written down as ekphonetic and Masoretic accents); exact pitch is not recoverable

breath_group_options.sense_lines: split at clause boundaries, max 18 syllables
breath_group_options.manuscript_lines: line breaks of the chosen manuscript (P66/P75/01/03)

tempo._evidence: rounds 9-10: the prologue's breath groups average 12.5 syllables; about 8 breaths a minute at chant pace

dynamics._evidence: round 10: noise-share map; the quiet valley 14:30-16:33

synagogue.note: stone hall, benches on three sides (Gamla, Magdala type)

ephesus_theatre.note: large open-air theatre, strong early reflections

space._evidence: estimates by room type; the engine's modal rooms (engine.MODAL_ROOMS) for the temple spaces

responses.where: after 'Amen, amen' sayings, the reader may pause for the hearers' amen

session_options.festival: John 2 Passover, 5 a feast, 6 Passover, 7-9 Tabernacles, 10 Dedication, 11-19 Passover

performance._evidence: the festival sequence is John's own; the session split is configurable

markers._evidence: from DISCOVERIES.md; each marker is attached to the syllables where it occurs
